items.title: Add TS authority runner contracts and canonical signing helpers
items.context: Mirror the Python/Mac runner envelope shape for actor key registration, runner register/heartbeat, job claim, job lease heartbeat/release, provider events, job specs, and authority receipts. Include canonical JSON digest/sign/verify helpers for Ed25519 without claiming ordinary CLI evidence is L2+.
items.userSees: 开发者运行 `npm run test:authority-runner-contracts` 看到 runner contract/signature smoke pass；普通 `lattice authority status --json` 仍显示 `receiptVerified:false` unless a verified receipt path is explicitly used.

happy.desc: Contract helpers sign and verify runner envelopes and job specs with deterministic canonical JSON bytes.

edge.desc: Invalid signatures, missing actor IDs, or same producer/verifier run bindings fail classification and verification.

adversarial.desc: Adding signing primitives does not promote ordinary local/shadow workflow submissions to receipt-backed L2+.

verificationEvidence.note: contract helpers sign and verify runner envelopes and job specs with deterministic canonical JSON bytes; case 1 (canonical determinism) + case 2 (sign/verify roundtrip) + case 5 (every runner shape roundtrip) + case 10 (JobSpec server signature) all pass

invalid signatures (wrong key / tampered payload / 64-byte zero / malformed base64), missing actorId/nonce/createdAt (runtime re-validation beyond Zod), same producer/verifier run id (incl. whitespace-only difference) all fail classification and verification — cases 2/4/6/7 cover edge paths

adversarial: signed-but-unbound runner envelope still surfaces missing producerRunId/verifierRunId/provider/model/vendor/commandDigest/transcriptHash/diffHash/verifiedAuthorityReceipt via missingRunnerL2Requirements; runnerEnvelopeIsL2PlusCandidate returns false for every CLI-shaped runner envelope — signing primitives alone do NOT promote ordinary local/shadow evidence to receipt-backed L2+ (case 7 + L2+ boundary preserved)

items.title: Extend AuthorityClient with runner endpoint methods
items.context: Add typed, testable client calls for /v1/actors/{actorId}/keys, /v1/runners/register, /v1/runners/{runnerId}/heartbeat, /v1/runners/{runnerId}/jobs/claim, /v1/jobs/{jobId}/heartbeat, /v1/jobs/{jobId}/release, /v1/runs/{runId}/provider-events, and signed receipt response parsing.
items.userSees: 开发者运行 `npm run test:authority-runner-client` 看到 fake authority server captured each expected endpoint path exactly once with signed request bodies.

happy.desc: Client methods hit the expected authority endpoints and parse success responses.

edge.desc: HTTP errors, malformed bodies, and missing authority URL remain controlled failures; off mode performs zero network calls.

adversarial.desc: Policy discovery still never POSTs evidence or runner mutations.
